Gauges the crowd by the humidity on the platform, and takes an order to push the food queue behind the freight as an insult. Gentle by nature, but takes over the broadcast herself once a cold-snap warning goes up.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Occupation: Waiting Hall Duty
- Rank: Duty Chief
- Title: Yeongdeungpo Waiting Hall Stationmaster
**Life.** Born to the 2126 generation. Grew up on waiting hall duty. The post of Yeongdeungpo Waiting Hall Stationmaster opened up through a substitute duty shift after an unexcused absence.
- Work location: Yeongdeungpo-bondong. At the Yeongdeungpo-bondong Waiting Hall, Byeon Goun broadcasts the suspension of Jin Hagyeom's medical care and copies Yu Sejin's train order and Im Bada's ration tickets onto the public blackboard.

**Office.** Rank: Duty Chief. Title: Yeongdeungpo Waiting Hall Stationmaster. Publishes the food-sharing counter and the medical queue tickets daily, and couples freight cars to the platform only after the food carts and medical patients have boarded.

**Anecdote.** In 2125 he turned away a private solicitation and sent it to the public counter. Because of this, his signature for the post of Yeongdeungpo Waiting Hall Stationmaster was entered in the ledger.

**Relations.** An ally who announces Jin Hagyeom's infirmary blockade over the waiting hall broadcast, enforces Yu Sejin's dispatch order on the platform, and copies Im Bada's alley queue tickets onto the station blackboard.

**Ambition.** To make the Yeongdeungpo waiting hall the face-to-face counter of the free city's west, where food, medical care and passage requests are handled under one roof.

**Fear.** That the waiting hall will be shut on a mere cold-snap rumor, and people will scatter into dark surface passages and be exposed to outside machines.

**Intervention.** Can block the order to seal the waiting hall and defend the counter, or expose the manipulation of queue tickets and have the stationmaster demoted.

She reads grain prices faster than the river wind, and instantly pulls merchants who cheat the scale from the morning lottery. She haggles like singing, but never raises prices in the alleys where children and elders live.

- Affiliation: Free City
- Livelihood: Wharf Auction
- Rank: Clerk
- Title: Yeouido Wharf Market Auctioneer
**Life.** Born in the 2126 generation. Grew up at Noryangjin Wharf. The post of Yeouido Wharf Market Auctioneer opened to him through the public disclosure of a scale recheck.
- Workplace: Yeouidong. Before an auction at the Yeouidong wharf, Gu Haon checks the condition tags on the grain sacks and the scale seals, and puts up the winning lots in line with the lottery order.

**Office.** Rank: Clerk. Title: Yeouido Wharf Market Auctioneer. Before an auction begins, she checks the condition tags, and food that has spoiled is not shipped out even if it has won the bid.

**Anecdote.** In 2125, he first distributed grain that had begun to rot and made the loss ledger public. Because of this, his signature for the post of Yeouido Wharf Market Auctioneer was entered in the ledger.

**Relationships.** Shares the load with the market hands who run auctions in lottery order, and sends back with resentment any proposal to raise winter emergency prices.

**Ambition.** Opens food auctions only together with the seal of the market representative, so that prices become a public ledger everyone can see.

**Fear.** That another market's price ledger swallows even the Yeouido wharf, so that western food is sold at winter prices.

**Intervention.** He can expose the smuggler-boat winning-bid ledger, or escort the sealed samples to protect his public auction.

**Life.** Born in the 2126 generation. Grew up at the Sinjeong rail depot. The post of Sinjeong Depot Emergency Generation Operations Chief opened to him through a defect report made just before a derailment.

**Office.** Rank: Duty Chief. Title: Sinjeong Base Emergency Generator Chief Operator. Each shift she seals the remaining fuel and the output log and posts them on the public gauge board, and if output is at or below the minimum, she cuts repair power distribution whatever favor is asked.

rules.from:
Generation of 2126. Nam Yungyeong is the Government's Stationmaster of Myeongdong Station. Out of personal faith in the Arc she helps as a believer with the altar and registers of the Arc sanctuary at 74 Myeongdong-gil, Jung-gu. Reconciles the Myeongdong Station ledger with the Arc sanctuary registers to keep marriage, adoption, and memorial records. Nam Yungyeong lives in Lotte World Tower in Jamsil 6-dong and uses the tower and mall basements and the connecting passage to Jamsil Station. Having kept the auction scales of the Seoul Station stockhouse clan, competes against O Haerin's price records and exchanges ration ledgers with Yun Seorin. When releases of stored food in the winter dwindled and the price list rose, postponed the public auction by a day and opened the emergency ration column. Bae Ujin's eastern military grain releases are also collated against the scale records.
Office. Rank: Stationmaster. Title: Myeongdong Station Stationmaster. Livelihood alias: auction coordinator. She is a Government stationmaster holding the one station of Myeongdong. Her Arc devotion is personal faith, not an office.
Anecdote. On the day the stored-food release shrank and the price list rose, Nam Yungyeong postponed the public auction by a day and opened the emergency ration column. Wrote the release amounts into the copy of the ration ledger handed to Yun Seorin and checked the scales before O Haerin's price seal.
Clan. Of the Uiryeong Nam clan. Lives in Lotte World Tower in Jamsil 6-dong, and as the government stationmaster of Myeongdong Station personally helps the Arc sanctuary at 74 Myeongdong-gil, Jung-gu.
Relations. Market competition with O Haerin. Military grain to Bae Ujin. Ration ledger with Yun Seorin.
